Phones are NOT stable here; phone_talia is transient but appears when resident_1 is present (p>0.50). notebook_marisol, charger_nico, and dog_leash are absent (p<0.10). d12 07:50 confirmed meds/mug_talia presence; score -13.18 due to underconfidence on phone_talia.

sink_k1: Primary storage for shared cookware (pan, pot, bowl) and phone_nico. High persistence (p>0.50-0.65) when resident_3 is present. Plates, mugs, keys, and water bottles are absent (p<0.05). d11 06:40 confirmed stability.

cupboard_k1: Holds plate_shared_1 (p>0.50). Keys, wallets, and meds are absent (p<0.05). Not a reliable spot for keys_nico.

nightstand_b1: Stable for glasses_marisol ONLY when resident_1 is present (p>0.70). Unstable when Marisol is absent (p<0.10). Do not assume stability without resident presence.

bedroom_3: Transient zones (desk/bed/floor). Not stable storage. Items move quickly to kitchen/counter. Empty despite resident presence implies items are elsewhere.

ON_PERSON: Marisol carries phone_marisol (p>0.80) when in bedroom_1. Keys/wallets are rarely carried (p<0.10). Talia/Nico carry little when in bedrooms. Nico's phone is likely in sink_k1, not ON_PERSON.

General: Resident presence dictates location. Common areas dominate daytime activity. Bedroom floors are not drop zones. Sink is a key drop zone for phones and cookware. Adjust priors down for non-core items in stable hubs to avoid overconfidence penalties."}
